findings.title: Independent audit shared canonical raw-row projection
findings.observation: The canonical and independent grouping paths both consumed PartialObservation values produced by project_native_row().
findings.risk: A defect in field selection or direct-value normalization could agree with itself and evade the independent audit.
findings.required_disposition: Implement a separately coded raw-row projection path in independent_audit.py that does not import or call state_projection.py.

findings.title: Policy-independent primary coverage lacked independent reconstruction
findings.observation: Mapping matrix, operational direct coverage, direct-or-derivable coverage, and common-missing-state outputs were produced only by the canonical mapping path.
findings.risk: A canonical mapping or coverage defect could be emitted without a separately reconstructed primary-endpoint comparison.
findings.required_disposition: Independently reconstruct and compare all policy-independent primary mapping and coverage outputs.

findings.title: Post-guard canonical orchestration lacked end-to-end synthetic execution
findings.observation: Canonical runner tests proved the authorization guard order but did not execute the complete verified-source to eight-artifact path.
findings.risk: Integration defects after the authorization guard could remain latent until the first real-data run.
findings.required_disposition: Run the complete canonical pipeline on tiny temporary synthetic CSV and ZIP fixtures, verify all eight artifacts, independent-audit agreement, and repeated-run byte determinism.

findings.title: Future execution transition could not be represented by isolated flag edits
findings.observation: The current contract loader intentionally requires the synthetic closed state, so isolated execution-flag changes would fail contract validation.
findings.risk: An ad hoc transition could create inconsistent authorization and implementation-phase state or pressure weakening of existing guards.
findings.required_disposition: Define an atomic closed-versus-open execution-phase contract; partial transitions must fail closed and the future open phase must require a separate canonical-run code freeze.

findings.title: Run manifest did not bind governance and implementation identities
findings.observation: The future run manifest recorded input identities and policy/dataset order but not SHA-256 identities of the governance records and executable modules used for the run.
findings.risk: A result bundle could be harder to reproduce or attribute to the exact pre-result governance and implementation state.
findings.required_disposition: Record deterministic SHA-256 identities for the governing records and runtime implementation modules, verify them are unchanged before output, and include them in run_manifest.json.

change_rule: This record preserves the pre-real-data adversarial findings observed before any Study 9 real-row endpoint inspection. The findings must not be removed or rewritten based on later results; their remediation state is recorded prospectively in the protocol and implementation history.
